Virtual select ​

Example data, control text, messages and source comments may be in Chinese. Viewer controls and API headings use English. Untranslated API descriptions are marked.

Interactive examples, TypeScript and JavaScript source, and the generated API reference are included on this page. The dynamic-height reproduction is source-only and is not claimed to work.

When to use it ​

Use a virtual list for many options. height controls the viewport; itemHeight controls row height. Normalized options contain label/value/raw. This component makes no data requests; use corresponding Remote/Dict components for remote or dictionary data.

Single selection, filtering and events ​

Change reports a user commit; clear reports clearing. Disabled options cannot be selected. Control-level disabled preserves selected labels while preventing interaction. Focus/blur target the actual input.

<template>
	<div class="example">
		<AsamSelectV2
			ref="control"
			v-bind="{ clearable: true, filterable: true, 'aria-label': '团队' }"
			v-model="value"
			:options="options"
			@change="event = 'change: ' + String($event)"
			@clear="event = 'clear'"
		/>
		<div class="row">
			<AsamButton type="primary" @click="control?.focus()">聚焦</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton type="primary" @click="control?.blur()">失焦</AsamButton>
		</div>
		<output>值：{{ value }}；{{ event }}</output>
		<AsamSelectV2 :model-value="value" :options="options" disabled aria-label="禁用虚拟选择" />
	</div>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamSelectV2BasicExample' });
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamSelectV2, AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamSelectV2Expose } from '@asam-ui/ui';

const event = ref('尚未更改');

	{ label: '设计', value: 'design', raw: { code: 'design' } },

];

Try selection.

Object, array and string storage ​

valueMode=object returns complete normalized options. Multiple selection with array storage returns an array; string storage joins values with separator. Object mode cannot combine with string storage. Restoring numeric/boolean string values depends on the options; avoid equivalent string collisions. multipleLimit restricts actual selections and removing a tag permits another selection. The example shows default collapsed tags, object clearing to null, arrays and separated-string models.

Example source ZIPComplete project ZIP

<template>
	<div class="example">
		<AsamSelectV2
			v-model="objectValue"
			:options="options"
			v-bind="{ 'value-mode': 'object', clearable: true, 'aria-label': '对象选择' }"
		/>
		<AsamSelectV2
			v-model="arrayValue"
			:options="options"
			v-bind="{
				multiple: true,
				'collapse-tags': true,
				'collapse-tags-tooltip': true,
				'aria-label': '数组选择'
			}"
		/>
		<AsamSelectV2
			v-model="stringValue"
			:options="options"
			v-bind="{
				multiple: true,
				'multiple-value-mode': 'string',
				separator: '|',
				'aria-label': '字符串选择'
			}"
		/>
		<AsamSelectV2
			v-model="limitedValue"
			:options="options"
			multiple
			:multiple-limit="1"
			aria-label="最多一项"
		/>
		<output data-object>{{ JSON.stringify(objectValue) }}</output>
		<output data-array>{{ JSON.stringify(arrayValue) }}</output>
		<output data-string>{{ stringValue }}</output>
		<output data-limited>{{ JSON.stringify(limitedValue) }}</output>
	</div>
</template>

];
const objectValue = ref<(typeof options)[number] | null>(options[0]);

];

Virtual options and list slots ​

The default slot receives item/index/disabled; header/footer add list content. The inlined options helper generates normalized data and is included in copied/downloaded Demo.vue source.

Example: slots

<template>
	<div class="example">
		<AsamSelectV2
			v-model="value"
			v-bind="{
				...{ options: options, height: 220, 'item-height': 36 },
				...{ filterable: true, 'aria-label': '虚拟选项' }
			}"
		>
			<template #default="{ item, index }">{{ index + 1 }} · {{ item.label }}</template>

			<template #footer>虚拟列表</template>

</template>

defineOptions({ name: 'AsamSelectV2SlotsExample' });
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamSelectV2 } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { makeOptions } from './options.js';
const options = makeOptions(500);
const value = ref<number | null>(1);

ts
export function makeOptions(count: number) {
	return Array.from({ length: count }, (_, i) => ({
		label: '选项 ' + (i + 1),
		value: i + 1,
		raw: { id: i + 1 }
	}));
}

js
export function makeOptions(count) {
	return Array.from({ length: count }, (_, i) => ({
		label: '选项 ' + (i + 1),
		value: i + 1,
		raw: { id: i + 1 }
	}));
}

Try list slots.

With verified inputs on dependency 2.14.7 / Vue 3.5.34, an instance mounted without a default slot did not display content when that slot was later added dynamically. Native Virtual Select and ASAM native matched. A fresh instance supplied with the slot at mount displayed it. This initial-absence-to-addition case is a native compatibility limitation; visibility is not guaranteed. Slot replacement, removal and other slots have separate verification results.

Sizes and inheritance ​

Four examples explicitly use large/big/default/small. Omitted sizes respond to ConfigProvider; explicit values override ancestors. Panels without a size contract do not receive an extra size prop.

Example: sizes

Show source
Example source ZIPComplete project ZIP
vue
<template>
	<div class="example">
		<div class="density-grid">
			<section data-density="large">
				<strong>large</strong>
				<AsamSelectV2
					v-bind="{ size: 'large', 'model-value': 'design', 'aria-label': '尺寸选择' }"
					:options="options"
				/>
			</section>
			<section data-density="big">
				<strong>big</strong>
				<AsamSelectV2
					v-bind="{ size: 'big', 'model-value': 'design', 'aria-label': '尺寸选择' }"
					:options="options"
				/>
			</section>
			<section data-density="default">
				<strong>default</strong>
				<AsamSelectV2
					v-bind="{ size: 'default', 'model-value': 'design', 'aria-label': '尺寸选择' }"
					:options="options"
				/>
			</section>
			<section data-density="small">
				<strong>small</strong>
				<AsamSelectV2
					v-bind="{ size: 'small', 'model-value': 'design', 'aria-label': '尺寸选择' }"
					:options="options"
				/>
			</section>
		</div>
		<AsamConfigProvider :size="density">
			<section data-density="inherited">
				<AsamSelectV2 model-value="design" :options="options" aria-label="尺寸选择" />
			</section>
		</AsamConfigProvider>
		<div class="row" role="group" aria-label="继承尺寸">
			<span>继承尺寸</span>
			<AsamButton type="default" @click="density = 'small'">small</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton type="default" @click="density = 'big'">big</AsamButton>
		</div>
		<output>配置提供器：{{ density }}</output>
	</div>
</template>

];

ASAM extensions and migration ​

ASAM adds four densities, normalized options, valueMode, multipleValueMode and separator. Raw object values require native mode with valueKey. Object mode stores normalized options and retains original business data in raw. Empty single selection is null; empty multiple selection is [] or an empty string. Unresolved values do not trigger requests. loading/remote/remoteMethod are caller-controlled search inputs; use Remote components for full asynchronous lifecycles.

Canonical source options replacing locally created options ​

Creation first returns the factory's complete option. When the source later supplies a canonical option with the same value, clearing and reselecting the original creation text returns the source label/value/raw. Both visible selected tags and selectedLabel use the canonical label, even when factory/source labels omit the typed text. Clearing the model preserves created options; clearCreatedOptions preserves the current model. The example updates static options; Remote/Dict components own real remote lifecycles.

Large-list filtering, edge events and creation ​

Virtual lists render rows near the viewport. height controls viewport height and itemHeight controls row height. The last filtered option remains selectable; selected labels survive list closure and further filtering. end-reached(direction) is the actual native list-edge event, not a renamed scroll callback. Default slots receive normalized item/index/disabled. Native mode supports custom field and group mapping through props.

Creation shares Select's createOption contract: ordinary records produce complete label/value/raw; custom entities require a synchronous factory. Clearing returns null or an empty array. Deduplication preserves actual value types. clearCreatedOptions only resets locally created options; use it on logical source/scope changes, not searches, refreshes or errors.

Raw fields and grouping ​

Native mode uses raw options. props.options maps group children; value/label/disabled map item identity/text/disabled flags. Group headings and disabled options remain real virtual-list rows. Native object mode requires valueKey. Do not mix raw field mapping into normalized ASAM object mode.

Creating custom entities ​

The example compares default ordinary records with custom numeric entities. Its factory only creates local entities; the host must explicitly persist them remotely. Selection makes no remote requests and fabricates no business fields. defaultFirstOption permits Enter to select the first option after typing; created selections still follow the complete-object model. reserveKeyword=false clears the query after multiple-selection commits without clearing created options.

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamSelectV2, AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamOption, AsamRecord, AsamCreateOption, AsamSelectV2Expose } from '@asam-ui/ui';
interface Person {
	id: number;
	name: string;
}
const record = ref<AsamOption<string, AsamRecord> | null>(null);
const people = ref<AsamOption<number, Person>[]>([]);
const custom = ref<AsamSelectV2Expose>();
const filled: AsamOption<string, AsamRecord> = {
	value: 'filled',
	label: '已回填',
	raw: { value: 'filled', label: '已回填' }
};
const options: AsamOption<number, Person>[] = [
	{ value: 7, label: '已有实体 7', raw: { id: 7, name: '已有实体 7' } }
];
const createPerson: AsamCreateOption<number, Person> = (text) => {
	const id = Number(text);
	if (!Number.isFinite(id)) throw new TypeError('请输入有限数字编号');
	return { value: id, label: `实体 ${id}`, raw: { id, name: text } };
};
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamSelectV2CreateDemo' });
</script>

Custom tags, loading and clearing ​

Tag receives data/selectDisabled/deleteTag; label receives index/label/value. Index is number; label/value keep open native slot types, so operations must match actual values. Default rendering supports collapseTags, maxCollapseTags, collapseTagsTooltip and tagTooltip. Explicit tagTooltip fields take precedence over inherited popup settings. Custom tag slots own layout. multipleLimit limits selected counts; loading/empty display loading/no results. emptyValues/valueOnClear define empty and clear values. A numeric fitInputWidth fixes popup width; booleans choose input alignment or content sizing. estimatedOptionHeight enables dynamic estimates; otherwise itemHeight fixes row height.

Asynchronous search callbacks ​

filterable + remote + remoteMethod forwards input to the caller. Base V2 makes no provider requests. The example simulates local asynchronous filtering and rejects late results with a generation counter. debounce controls delay; remoteShowSuffix retains the suffix. Use RemoteSelectV2 for complete request/source lifecycles.

Example: search

Show source
Example source ZIPComplete project ZIP
vue
<template>
	<div class="example">
		<AsamSelectV2
			v-model="value"
			:options="options"
			filterable
			remote
			remote-show-suffix
			:remote-method="search"
			:debounce="0"
			:loading="loading"
			:reserve-keyword="false"
			clearable
			aria-label="异步筛选演示"
		>
			<template #loading>正在筛选本地模拟数据</template>
			<template #empty>没有匹配项</template>
		</AsamSelectV2>
		<output>输入：{{ query }}；选择：{{ value }}；加载：{{ loading }}</output>
	</div>
</template>
<script lang="ts" setup>
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamSelectV2 } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamOption } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const value = ref<string | null>(null);
const query = ref('');
const loading = ref(false);
const source = ['设计', '开发', '测试'].map((value) => ({ value, label: value, raw: { value } }));
const options = ref<AsamOption<string>[]>(source);
let generation = 0;
async function search(text: string) {
	query.value = text;
	const ownGeneration = ++generation;
	loading.value = true;
	await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 180));
	if (ownGeneration !== generation) return;
	options.value = source.filter((option) => option.label.includes(text));
	loading.value = false;
}
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamSelectV2SearchDemo' });
</script>

	gap: var(--asam-space-md, 16px);

			:reserve-keyword="false"
			clearable
			aria-label="异步筛选演示"
		>
			<template #loading>正在筛选本地模拟数据</template>
			<template #empty>没有匹配项</template>
		</AsamSelectV2>
		<output>输入：{{ query }}；选择：{{ value }}；加载：{{ loading }}</output>
	</div>
</template>
<script setup>
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamSelectV2 } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const value = ref(null);
const query = ref('');
const loading = ref(false);
const source = ['设计', '开发', '测试'].map((value) => ({ value, label: value, raw: { value } }));
const options = ref(source);
let generation = 0;
async function search(text) {
	query.value = text;
	const ownGeneration = ++generation;
	loading.value = true;
	await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 180));
	if (ownGeneration !== generation) return;
	options.value = source.filter((option) => option.label.includes(text));
	loading.value = false;
}
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamSelectV2SearchDemo' });
</script>
<style scoped>
.example {
	display: grid;
	gap: var(--asam-space-md, 16px);
}
</style>

Try asynchronous callbacks.

Stable identity for raw objects ​

Native mode can store business objects directly, using valueKey for identity. Restoring a new object with the same id displays the source option's label. Selection returns the raw value object, without an ASAM option/raw wrapper. Single clearing and empty multiple arrays follow native behavior. Disabled options remain unselectable; multipleLimit constrains counts.

Empty strings, clearing and default collapsed tags ​

Empty strings can be valid options. Native emptyValues explicitly excludes them and valueOnClear explicitly returns null. Explicit tagTooltip overrides inherited popperClass/effect under default rendering. maxCollapseTags limits visible tags. Custom tags replace default layout, so this separate example verifies default collapsed tooltips.

Popup width and fixed row height ​

fitInputWidth=false sizes to content, true aligns with the input, and a number fixes width. itemHeight fixes row height while the default slot customizes contents. estimatedOptionHeight enables dynamic measurement. Width and row-height strategies are independent.

Dynamic-height and content-update compatibility limitations ​

estimatedOptionHeight, itemHeight and list slots pass directly to the pinned 2.14.7 native virtual list. The example provides varying content heights and content updates. Measurement, caching and scrolling follow native limitations. ASAM adds no measuring layer, VNode-height patches or cache resets. Omitting estimatedOptionHeight selects native fixed-height behavior.

On 2.14.7, the complete example became unresponsive on first mount. The same input timed out with native Virtual Select and ASAM native/advanced paths. It remains a reproduction of a compatibility limitation: rendering, content updates and scrolling have not passed verification. Use virtual/layout for working fixed-height examples.

The Chinese page shows complete TS/JS reproduction source without automatically running it. Language switching, copying and complete-file downloading remain available, as does the standalone reproduction link. Source display does not imply runtime success.

Reading the API ​

Advanced value/object modes default to a Chinese placeholder meaning “Please select”. Native mode preserves omission, explicit undefined/null/false and native defaults. Explicit popperClass remains and gains a density class. The removed popperAppendToBody is replaced by teleported to enable transfer and appendTo to choose its target.

The reference uses actual public types and runtime defaults. Combined props apply by branch; unknown or undeclared defaults do not mean false or empty. Complete Demo.vue files inline local helpers, data and assets.

Native delegation and advanced object labels ​

Native tag scope uses the pinned public Option[]; value/label/disabled and custom fields follow options/props mapping. DeleteTag receives MouseEvent and that native item. This type differs from classic Select's OptionBasic and is not reduced to unknown.

Try native tags.

Native mode directly delegates filtering, creation, IME, keyboard and virtual scrolling. Advanced object mode saves complete createOption results locally and uses the public label slot for canonical labels, without changing native selectedLabel or internal states. selectedLabel reads native values in native mode and canonical labels in object mode; custom label slots still take precedence. Native keyboard-creation and dynamic-height issues are recorded with equivalent native inputs, not taken over by the wrapper.

Local and global popups ​

Basic usage uses default global mounting; display explicitly configures teleported or appendTo. Open the popup before checking its container. Placement is independent of values and request protocols.
